Here is the **Codebase Summary** of `/home/pmpmt`:

---

## Overview: Pi Coding Agent Configuration Environment

This is **not a single software project** — it's the personalized configuration, automation tooling, and web dashboard ecosystem for the **Pi coding agent** running on an Ubuntu laptop (ThinkPad T15 Gen 2i) in Vila Real, Portugal. Everything revolves around `~/.pi/` (a git-tracked directory). The Pi agent itself is at `v0.80.10`, running on Node v24.18.0 via nvm.

---

## Architecture at a Glance

```
~/.pi/
├── agent/                  ← Pi agent core config, sessions, skills, prompts
├── agent-frontend/         ← Specialist agent workspace (multi-agent orchestrator)
├── apps-scripts/           ← Python tools (backup engine, speech-to-text, text rewrite)
├── cron/                   ← Cron scheduler engine (jobs.json, run history, TS core)
├── html/                   ← Pi Dashboard — web UI served on port 3000
├── miscelaneous_documentation/  ← Setup & architecture reports for everything built
├── github-settings/        ← GitHub integration config
├── AGENTS.md               ← Orchestrator agent instructions (delegation protocol)
└── .env                    ← All secrets & API keys (gitignored, sourced at launch)
```

---

## Major Systems

### 1. Pi Dashboard (`~/.pi/html/`)
A multi-section web UI served by `server.mjs` on port 3000. Includes:

| Section | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/` (Home) | Landing page with live summary strip (tokens today, backup health, recent activity) |
| `/token-tracker` | Full analytics — per-turn tokens/cost, daily charts, model breakdown, conversation drill-down. Backed by SQLite (`token_usage_tracker.db`), auto-syncs every 30s |
| `/backup/` | Backup tool dashboard — manual triggers, OAuth re-auth, settings, run history, log viewer |
| `/skills/` | Skills hub — inventory of installed agent skills |
| `/video-finder` | YouTube similar video search dashboard |
| `/codebase-summary` | AI-generated live summary of the Pi codebase (with history) |
| `/agentmap` | Agent map / operations console (D3.js mind map, proposed for rewrite to live ops dashboard) |

The server also exposes REST APIs: `/api/summary`, `/api/conversations`, `/api/daily`, `/api/models`, `/api/agents`, `/api/config`, `/api/capabilities`, etc.

### 2. Agent Configuration (`~/.pi/agent/`)

```
agent/
├── settings.json           ← Theme (dark), default model (deepseek-v4-pro), thinking (high),
│                             compaction (enabled), steering (one-at-a-time), packages list
├── auth.json               ← Provider API keys ($VAR references to .env)
├── AGENTS.md               ← Orchestrator role: delegation-only, uses spawn_agent, 1 specialist (Front-End)
├── models-store.json       ← Available models by provider
├── prompts/                ← Custom prompt templates (readocs, short, document)
├── skills/                 ← Installed skills (gog-workspace, video-finder)
├── extensions/             ← Custom extensions (cron.ts, git-commit.ts)
├── sessions/               ← Per-workspace JSONL session logs
├── observability/          ← Run logs (runs.jsonl)
└── npm/node_modules/       ← Installed Pi packages (pi-web-access, pi-agent-browser-native, pi-agents-pool)
```

### 3. Installed Pi Packages

| Package | Provides |
|---|---|
| `pi-web-access` | `web_search`, `fetch_content`, `get_search_content` tools; librarian skill; multi-provider search |
| `pi-agent-browser-native` | `agent_browser` tool — full CDP browser automation, snapshots, form fills, Electron, QA presets |
| `pi-agents-pool` | `spawn_agent`, `send_input`, `wait_agent`, `close_agent`, `resume_agent` — multi-agent delegation |

### 4. Multi-Agent Orchestrator
- **Orchestrator** (`~/.pi/agent/`): Delegates tasks to specialists via `spawn_agent`, never executes directly
- **Front-End Specialist** (`~/.pi/agent-frontend/`): Own workspace with AGENTS.md, APPEND_SYSTEM.md, settings.json, isolated sessions
- Communication: JSON-line RPC over stdin/stdout, auto-steer via `<subagent_notification>` injection
- Depth limit: `PI_SUBAGENT_MAX_DEPTH=2`

### 5. Cron Job System (`~/.pi/cron/` + `~/.pi/agent/extensions/cron.ts`)
First-class in-process scheduler:
- **Schedule types**: `at` (one-shot), `every` (interval), `cron` (5-field expressions with timezone)
- **Persistence**: `jobs.json` + per-job JSONL run history
- **Active jobs**:
  - **Daily Laptop Backup** — runs `20 8 * * *` Europe/Lisbon, triggers backup via agentTurn
  - **gog-token-keepalive** — daily `gog drive ls` to refresh OAuth token

### 6. Laptop Backup Tool (`~/.pi/apps-scripts/backup_laptop_tool/`)
Python engine (invoked as subprocess by Node):
- Creates `tar.gz` snapshots of `~/.pi` with configurable blacklist
- Uploads to Google Drive (`neopmpmtj@gmail.com`) with retention management
- Systemd timer triggers 5 min after boot; also fireable via dashboard
- OAuth with service account, no expiry
- Credentials centralized in `~/.pi/agent/.env`

### 7. Speech-to-Text & Text Rewrite (`~/.pi/apps-scripts/on-demand-stt-rewrite/`)
Python tool for hotkey-based recording (Ctrl+Alt), OpenAI Whisper transcription, auto-paste. Includes web dashboard on port 8030 for runtime settings changes (language, model, timestamp).

### 8. Extensions (`~/.pi/agent/extensions/`)

| Extension | Description |
|---|---|
| `cron.ts` | Full cron scheduler engine — `cron` agent tool + `/cron` TUI command |
| `git-commit.ts` | `/commit [message]` — stages all changes and commits (default: "checkpoint") |

### 9. Skills

| Skill | Provider | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `gog-workspace` | Local | Google Workspace CLI (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, Docs) |
| `video-finder` | Local | YouTube similar video search, filtered by duration/recency/views |
| `librarian` | `pi-web-access` | Open-source research with GitHub source citations |

### 10. Documentation (`~/.pi/miscelaneous_documentation/`)
Every major system has a detailed setup report:
- Backup laptop tool setup
- Context flow in Pi (prompt structure)
- Cron job system setup
- Multi-agent orchestrator setup
- Pi reference (startup options)
- Token usage dashboard setup
- Speech-to-text keyboard shortcut fix (debug reports)
- Skill stale commands fix

---

## Key Technology Stack

| Layer | Technologies |
|---|---|
| **Agent runtime** | `pi-coding-agent` v0.80.10, Node.js v24.18.0, TypeScript |
| **AI provider** | DeepSeek (direct, v4-pro / v4-flash), OpenRouter available for vision |
| **Web dashboard** | Vanilla Node.js HTTP server, vanilla JS/CSS (no frameworks), SQLite |
| **Python tools** | Python 3, Flask/Django for STT dashboard, google-api-python-client for Drive |
| **System** | Ubuntu 24.04, systemd units, snap packages (Telegram, Firefox, Tailscale) |
| **CLI tools** | `gog` (Google Workspace), `gh` (GitHub), `yt-dlp` (YouTube) |

---

## Configuration Highlights

- **Theme**: dark | **Compaction**: enabled | **Thinking**: high
- **Steering**: one-at-a-time | **Follow-up**: one-at-a-time
- **Default model**: `deepseek-v4-pro` | **Flash**: `deepseek-v4-flash`
- **Location context**: Auto-detected (Vila Real, Portugal, Europe/Lisbon)
- **Secrets**: All in `~/.pi/agent/.env`, resolved via `$VAR` in `auth.json`

summary.raw:
Here's a summary of this codebase:

---

## Overview

This is a **Pi Coding Agent harness** — a deeply customized AI agent workspace running on `pi-coding-agent` v0.80.10 (Node v24.18.0). It's not a traditional software project; it's a personal AI orchestrator with multiple integrated dashboards, tools, skills, and automation. Located in `/home/pmpmt/.pi/`.

The owner lives in **Vila Real, Portugal** and uses **DeepSeek v4 Pro** as the default thinking model.

---

## Architecture

### Multi-Agent Orchestrator
The core agent (`~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md`) is an **Orchestrator** — it delegates tasks to specialist sub-agents using `pi-agents-pool` (spawn/send/wait/close/resume). Currently one specialist exists:
- **Front-End** specialist (`~/.pi/agent-frontend/`) — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, UI work. Has its own independent workspace, settings, and isolated sessions.

### Pi Dashboard (`~/.pi/html/`)
A Node.js HTTP server (`server.mjs`, port 3000) serving a unified dashboard with:

| Section | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Home** | `/` | Landing page with live summary strips (tokens today, backup status, recent activity) |
| **Token Tracker** | `/token-tracker/` | Full analytics: per-turn cost/tokens, daily stats, model/agent breakdown, conversation drill-downs. SQLite backend auto-syncs from session files every 30s |
| **Backup Tool** | `/backup/` | Google Drive `.tar.gz` snapshots of `~/.pi`. Boot-triggered via systemd timer, with manual trigger and OAuth re-auth from the web UI |
| **Skills Hub** | `/skills/` | Browse installed agent skills with metadata |
| **Agent Map** | `/agentmap/` | Interactive D3.js mind map of the Pi agent architecture |
| **Video Finder** | `/video-finder/` | YouTube video discovery dashboard |
| **Codebase Summary** | `/codebase-summary/` | On-demand codebase summarization (spawns `pi --print` to generate summaries, stores in `store.json`) |

### Installed Packages
- **`pi-web-access`** — Web search, fetch_content, get_search_content, librarian skill
- **`pi-agent-browser-native`** — Full browser automation (open, snapshot, click, fill, eval, Electron)
- **`pi-agents-pool`** — Multi-agent spawning, pooling, communication

### Skills (2 local + 1 package)
- **gog-workspace** — Google Workspace CLI (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, Docs)
- **video-finder** — YouTube video discovery by topic/style/reference
- **librarian** — Deep open-source library research with source citations (bundled with pi-web-access)

### Extensions (`~/.pi/agent/extensions/`)
- **`git-commit.ts`** — `/commit [message]` command
- **`cron.ts`** — `/cron` TUI command + `cron` tool for the agent
- **`observability/index.ts`** — Agent observability extension

### Cron Job System (`~/.pi/cron/`)
In-process scheduler with 3 schedule types (`at`/`every`/`cron`), JSON persistence, JSONL run history, and agent-accessible CRUD. Timer capped at 60s to recover from laptop sleep.

### Apps-Scripts (`~/.pi/apps-scripts/`)
- **`on-demand-stt-rewrite/`** — Python speech-to-text + text rewriting with PyAutoGUI, Xlib, pydantic
- **`backup_laptop_tool/`** — Python backup engine that creates `.tar.gz` snapshots and uploads to Google Drive

### Custom Prompts (`~/.pi/agent/prompts/`)
- `readocs.md` — reads all Pi documentation for full context
- `short.md` — summarization prompt
- `document.md` — document-related prompt

### Configuration Files
| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `~/.pi/agent/settings.json` | All Pi settings (models, theme, packaging, steering) |
| `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` | Provider API keys (resolved from `.env`) |
| `~/.pi/agent/.env` | Secrets (Google OAuth, API keys) |
| `~/.pi/agent/web-search.json` | Web search configuration |
| `~/.pi/agent/APPEND_SYSTEM.md` | Auto-detected location context |
| `~/.pi/agents/APPEND_SYSTEM.md` | Shared append system instructions |

### Key Design Decisions
- **Secrets in `.env`** — API keys are stored in `~/.pi/agent/.env` and referenced in `auth.json` via `$VAR` interpolation
- **Git-tracked** — The entire `~/.pi/` directory is a git repo with a `.gitignore` that excludes secrets, sessions, node_modules, and binaries
- **Dark theme**, compaction enabled, one-at-a-time steering/follow-up mode
